reference.name: Best possible plan (central MILP, perfect information)

headline.text: Q-Grid lands 0.8% from the best possible plan; the closest alternative without a central controller, Per-building MPC (MILP), lands 21.7% (paired Wilcoxon p < 0.001).
headline.detail: Among methods that work without a central controller, Q-Grid is closest to the best possible plan on 4 of 5 campuses; elsewhere (BDG2 university site 'Cockatoo' (New York)) another method is closer.

step1.text: Today each building runs on its own: critical loads lose power 16 min a day and the bill is Rs 177,985 a day.

step7.text: Q-Grid cuts critical downtime from 16 min to 8 min a day (0 min counting only shortfalls above 1 %), saves 3.3% on the bill versus today, and lands 0.8% from the best possible plan.
step7.comms: When the campus network fails for 3 hours, central control loses 3.5 points of gap and Q-Grid 2.1, because each building keeps optimising on its own.
